title: Non-anchor position period prediction v12
rationale: This lane fixes a position-only period rule before adding any new key material or scoring any public-anchor-derived fragments. It is a preregistered prediction target for future non-anchor evidence, not another pass over EAST, NORTHEAST, BERLIN, or CLOCK fragment matches.
prediction_target: Future independently obtained non-anchor K4 observations should be enriched in the predeclared absolute-position residue classes for the registered periods before any candidate-word, offset, or route tuning is performed.
discovery_inputs: Absolute one-based K4 position numbers only
Non-anchor position universe emitted by non-anchor-positions
Deterministic residue-class rule emitted before observing new source-backed evidence
evaluation_inputs: Committed observation files that reject public anchor positions 22 through 34 and 64 through 74
Independent target rows not derived from EAST, NORTHEAST, BERLIN, or CLOCK known-plaintext fragments
controls: multiple-comparison correction across registered periods and residue classes
held-out non-anchor observation scoring before any lane promotion
